title: Pathfinder3 ledger verdict event
$comment: One line of pathfinder3/ledger/verdicts.jsonl. See plans/pathfinder3-ledger-refactor-design.md. schema_version 2 replaces the pathfinder3/protocol/pair_matrix.schema.json v1 nested-verdict shape (archived).

instrument_id.$comment: null on migrated historical rows (legacy series identified by judge+prompt_version); the 64-char sha256 hex digest of the instrument's identity record for every new event.

score_explanation.$comment: Why corr/int were assigned. Non-null required on events with a non-null instrument_id (enforced in code, not schema); migrated rows carry the historical rationale verbatim.

derived_idea.$comment: One paragraph on the concrete connection/application the pair suggests, or null when the judge finds none. Key is always present; null on every historical row.

repeat.$comment: Optional key, present and true ONLY on deliberate repeatability probes; absent otherwise.

yield_kind.$comment: Optional key, written only by output contract v6. Names what the pair yields: an experiment, a connection of another kind, or neither. Absent on every v2 and v4 row. Three-valued because a boolean pools 'connection' with 'none' -- a junk pair implies no experiment either -- which is the class v6 exists to find pooled with the noise it exists to reject. It also separates two readings of `corr` that are NOT commensurable: feasibility answers 'could the experiment be run' for `experiment`, and 'what would it take to establish the connection' otherwise. Do not pool those populations on a single threshold without deciding that explicitly.
